description: This header file declares functions and enums for socket configuration and connection handling, including setting socket options and attempting to connect to hosts or addresses.

methods.name: socketHelperConfigure
methods.description: Configures a socket with options such as binding to a device, setting for cellular routing, and disabling SIGPIPE.

methods.name: socketHelperTryConnectHost
methods.description: Attempts to connect a socket to a specified hostname and port.

methods.name: socketHelperTryConnectAddr
methods.description: Attempts to connect a socket to a specified sockaddr address.
